www.title: Everchat - Public comments on any URL
www.metaDescription: Every URL deserves a conversation. Anonymous Chrome side-panel comments. No email. No ads. No third-party trackers.
www.heroLede: Anonymous public comments in a Chrome side panel. No email. No third-party trackers. No ads. Free forever.
www.installAria: Install Everchat from the Chrome Web Store
www.chromeStoreBadgeAlt: Available in the Chrome Web Store
www.donateAria: Donate to Everchat via Open Collective
www.benefit1Body: Open the side panel on any tab. News, government, docs, anything with a link. Same URL, same room. You never leave the page.
www.benefit2Body: We do not hire moderators to police speech. Votes collapse junk; collapsed comments stay expandable. Karma marks reputation in the room.
www.benefit3Body: No third-party trackers. No email. Passkeys when you speak. We don't build an ad profile of you across the web.
www.benefit4Body: If many people use it, we may ask for donations via Open Collective to keep the lights on. Donations never buy ads, ranking, or special treatment.
www.installIntro: Load a local build in developer mode while the store listing is on the way, or anytime you want a build you control:
www.installStep1: Clone the Everchat repo and run pnpm install && pnpm build
www.installStep2: Open chrome://extensions and turn on Developer mode
www.installStep4: Pin Everchat and open the side panel on any page
